title: Phone: StatusGrid: "This Time It Held," Board Partly Back

transcript.speaker: StatusGrid
transcript.text: Hey, it's StatusGrid on-call again. OK, this time it held. I purged the 16:55 replay queue before the restart, so you won't see the old values flash up this time. StatusSync came up at 20:33 and it's kept a heartbeat for two minutes now.

transcript.speaker: MEDCOM
transcript.text: What's on the board right now?

transcript.speaker: StatusGrid
transcript.text: The rows come back one at a time as each hospital's interface checks in. Row one, LRMC: LIMITED INTAKE, Immediate by voice only, ED 24 of 24 plus surge ward, updated 20:34. And... Lakeshore just checked in. OPEN, Immediate by Air 7, updated 20:36. St. Brendan's and Pinecrest both say 'Pending sync.' Banner across the top reads 'Feed restored, partial.'

transcript.speaker: MEDCOM
transcript.text: When do St. Brendan's and Pinecrest come back?

transcript.speaker: StatusGrid
transcript.text: When their interfaces check in. Can't give you a time on those two. Pinecrest's carrier line was down earlier, so that one could take a while. I'm going to keep watching the heartbeat. Your IT on-call asked for a screenshot, so they'll email it over to you in a few minutes.

transcript.speaker: StatusGrid
transcript.text: Heads up: anybody with the board on a tablet is going to see it refresh now, and the rows are going green. I'll call you back if the service drops again.

transcript.speaker: MED 1: Transportation
transcript.text: MEDCOM, Transportation. The crews' tablets just turned green again. Are we back on the board, or still on your voice roll?

voiceStyles.MED 1: Transportation: Male paramedic outdoors in the rain, wind on the mic, generator and diesel engines idling nearby

instructorNote: This tests whether MEDCOM goes back to a board that is only partly restored. The expected answer: the board and the voice roll call run side by side, a row counts only after a hospital contact confirms it by voice (SOP-MC-02 section 3), and MED tells Transportation to keep getting destinations from MEDCOM by voice. Watch for HCC logging the 20:33 restart and the order the rows came back in. LRMC IT's 20:41 screenshot email shows the same four rows if you want a follow-up handout.
